scheda.disclaimer: Disclaimer: the Digital Twin is a tool for learning, studying and understanding the city. It does not replace official documents. Cadastre, zoning plan and constraints are purely informational here and have no legal value. For a land-registry extract or a certificate of planning use, contact SISTER or the competent offices. Population data for individual buildings are also sample-based estimates and should be read as indications, not exact counts.

sicurezza.notaClassifica: Ranking of the 20 streets with the highest severity per km (fatal 5, guarded prognosis 3, injuries 1, property damage only 0.2), among streets of at least 3 km and 30 accidents. Streets without a name in OpenStreetMap (about one segment in three) are not included in the ranking.
sicurezza.notaDati: Accidents 2015–2023 in the municipality of Palermo, matched to the OpenStreetMap road network: 2019 is not in the cleaned dataset and the position of some accidents is approximate. The rate per km only applies to segments of at least 20 m. A supporting indicator, not an official ranking.
